comment: Request shapes Claude Code 2.1.288 puts on the wire for the mod protocol, recorded byte for byte from one real session (Linux, real Claude config, plugin loaded with --plugin-dir into a scratch working folder, zero model turns). All five arrived from one peer pid read via SO_PEERCRED. Session ids scrubbed to <sid>. Header names arrive capitalised; a bodiless GET carries no Content-Length and no Content-Type, which is why the mod protocol is POST-only. test:claude-mod-framing replays rawBlockCRLF byte for byte.
note: The probe mod also dialled /claude/mod/status, borrowing the name of the legacy hooks leg. It is not part of the v1 protocol, so it is kept here as evidence of what the client sends and asserted to be refused with unknown_route.

requests.name: register
requests.rawBlockCRLF:
POST /claude/mod/register?sid=<sid> HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
Connection: keep-alive
User-Agent: Bun/1.4.3
Accept: */*
Host: cosyncing.local
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd
Content-Length: 117

requests.name: poll
requests.rawBlockCRLF:
POST /claude/mod/poll?sid=<sid> HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
Connection: keep-alive
User-Agent: Bun/1.4.3
Accept: */*
Host: cosyncing.local
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd
Content-Length: 52

requests.name: hold
requests.rawBlockCRLF:
POST /claude/mod/hold?sid=<sid> HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
Connection: keep-alive
User-Agent: Bun/1.4.3
Accept: */*
Host: cosyncing.local
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd
Content-Length: 101

requests.name: poll-get-no-body
requests.rawBlockCRLF:
GET /claude/mod/poll?sid=<sid>&wait=20000 HTTP/1.1
Connection: keep-alive
User-Agent: Bun/1.4.3
Accept: */*
Host: cosyncing.local
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd
requests.measuredOutcome: reject content-length-missing (what the spike reader answered)
requests.note: The spike reader accepted GET and rejected it for a missing Content-Length. The shipped reader is POST-only, so a GET is rejected on method before framing is considered. Kept with the original reason because that is what the client really sends.

requests.name: status
requests.rawBlockCRLF:
POST /claude/mod/status?sid=<sid> HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
Connection: keep-alive
User-Agent: Bun/1.4.3
Accept: */*
Host: cosyncing.local
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd
Content-Length: 52
requests.note: Recorded from the probe mod's own dial list. /claude/mod/status is not a v1 route; the shipped socket answers it with unknown_route, which is what the framing suite asserts.
